source: MaleCNS v1.0 flat connectome, minimum confidence 0.5 (FlyEM / HHMI Janelia and collaborators, CC BY 4.0)

selection.food: class=gustatory, subclass in ['labellar bristle', 'pharyngeal sensillum', 'taste peg'], top 16 by two-hop contact reach onto descending neurons
selection.threat: type in ['LPLC2', 'LC4', 'LC16'], top 16 by direct contacts onto descending neurons
selection.wall: type in ['LC11', 'LC15', 'LC17', 'LC21'], top 16 by direct contacts onto descending neurons
selection.prey: type in ['LC10a', 'LC10b', 'LC10c-1', 'LC10c-2', 'LC10d', 'LC10e'], top 16 by direct contacts onto descending neurons
selection.self: class = mechanosensory_proprioceptive, top 16 by direct contacts onto descending neurons
selection.readout: 32 descending neurons: top 16 by direct contacts from selected visual inputs, top 16 by two-hop reach from selected gustatory inputs, filled by combined rank
selection.bridge: 16 strongest gustatory-to-readout carriers plus 32 strongest general input-to-readout carriers (min of summed input and output contacts)
selection.edges: every measured directed edge among selected cells is retained
